core_obligations: Present the scheme (proof lines 2746-2758): write X as a quasi-compact open U of an affine scheme; covering U by finitely many standard opens exhibits X as the complement of the closed subset cut out by finitely many elements f_1, ..., f_n.

Construct the test scheme (proof lines 2758-2764): let T be the spectrum of the polynomial ring over A in one variable and the x_i modulo the single equation sum f_i x_i = 1; the structure morphism to Spec(A) factors through the open X, giving the required morphism T -> X.

Verify the base change (proof lines 2764-2798): for an affine X' = Spec(A') over X the images of the f_i generate the unit ideal in A'; writing the resulting relation s, one shows that the base change X' x_X T is the spectrum of A'[y_1, ..., y_n] by exhibiting explicit mutually inverse A'-algebra isomorphisms, whose verification reduces to three straightforward computations using the relation.
proof_roadmap: Present the quasi-affine scheme as the complement of finitely many equations in an affine scheme.
Use those equations to build a single affine scheme over X, the graph of the relation.
Check that over every affine test scheme the base change becomes an affine space by explicit formulae.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a quasi-affine scheme X there are an integer n and a morphism T -> X from an affine scheme such that over every affine scheme X' over X the base change is an affine space over X' (statement lines 2738-2744). The proof (proof lines 2746-2802) presents X as the complement of finitely many equations, builds T from those equations, and verifies the base change identification by exhibiting explicit mutually inverse isomorphisms. H3: an original explicit construction with a verification by formulae, written out in full.
